scope: federal, statewide, and legislative (State Senate and State House) only; no local, county, judicial retention, or ballot-issue contests

certification.note: The board met November 10, 2026. Auditor Kristi Racines moved to certify the statewide abstract for the 2026 General Election as the official State Canvass; Treasurer Curt Meier seconded; the motion passed unanimously. The certification page is signed “this 10th day of November.”
